name: Pitibum
description: Educational toy retailer in Montevideo with an online store on WooCommerce. Sells toys by age range, family games and learning products. States shipping across the country by DAC and Mirtrans; interior costs and times are quoted before payment.
description_es: Juguetería didáctica de Montevideo con tienda online en WooCommerce. Vende juguetes por edad, juegos familiares y productos educativos. Indica envíos a todo el país por DAC y Mirtrans; los costos y plazos al interior se consultan antes de pagar.

ships_to.notes: Shipping across the country by DAC and Mirtrans. Interior costs and times to be requested before payment.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup in the Tres Cruces area by prior phone coordination.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping by DAC and Mirtrans, pickup area, categories
